title: Fallback to blocked draft when support reply draft activity fails
answers: Why are support tickets stuck on Processing when the AI draft agent fails?
How does the support reply draft activity handle empty turns or agent crashes?
What prevents support tickets from staying in_progress after draft generation errors?
body:
Symptom: Support tickets stay stuck on "Processing" and never leave in_progress when the draft agent fails or ends without valid JSON.
Root cause: products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_draft_async raised an uncaught exception on all attempts, failing the Temporal workflow before a result was recorded.
Fix pattern: Raise DraftNotProducedError while llm_attempts() < DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS to trigger Temporal retry, but on the final attempt return a fallback SupportReplyDraft with verdict="blocked_on_knowledge" and confidence=0.0.
Constraints: Applies to support draft activities where terminal failure leaves tickets in_progress; must match RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS) in products/conversations/backend/temporal/pipeline.py:SupportReplyWorkflow.
applies: Support reply draft generation activity in Temporal conversations pipeline.
